facts.fact: Togo First reports that the Ministry of Territorial Administration began a review of the 2009 civil registration law at a scoping meeting in Lomé 'last week' (the week of 17-21 August 2026), to reflect decentralisation, the digitalisation of procedures and interoperability between administrative systems, with reform proposals expected before the end of 2026.

systems.tiers: online requests for copies of birth, marriage and death certificates for residents of five pilot municipalities since December 2025; Golfe 3 municipality's civil registration services integrated in February 2025 for certified extracts and full copies
national rollout; the document says civil registration is becoming more closely integrated with the identification system through it, without saying how

note: The only fact is the law review. The online service described is for requesting copies of acts; the document also mentions an August 2025 reform of the collection of statistics on births, deaths and marriages, with no system named.
